Dialogs.Dialog: Sorry to keep you waiting. Did you get wet in the rain？ Are you okay？
Did I keep you waiting？ Must've been cold out in the snow, right？
Nah, I just got here myself.
Right on time. Good boy, good boy.
Couldn't make you wait in the rain, after all.
Glad you made it on time. I thought you might be late because of the snow.
Glad I left a little early, then.
Sorry to keep you waiting! Did you get wet？
No, I'm fine. I don't mind the rain anyway. Let's go.
Sorry for making you wait in the snow.
No, it's okay. I was watching the snow, so I didn't get bored.
Sorry to make you wait in the rain! ...Are you mad？
Yep, furious. ...Just kidding. I'm just glad you didn't get in an accident or anything.
You're late! I was so cold. I thought I was gonna get buried in the snow.
I'm really sorry! You must've been freezing.
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！ Don't tell me...)
You were so late, I got worried and came over... Hey, what's wrong？ Are you okay？
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！ Don't tell me...)
Do you know what today is？
I'm sorry! I'll get ready right away!
It's okay, no need to rush. Just make sure you're more careful next time, okay？
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！ Don't tell me...)
Look at you. You've got bedhead.
Sorry. I'm ready to go now.
Yeah, all good. Shall we go, then？
(Maybe I got here a bit early... Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s already here.)
(Waiting for ●... Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like this is kind of nice. I'll watch for a bit.)
No way, were you watching me practice my smile？
(So that's what she was doing... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so cute.)
Excuse me, would you mind filling out a quick survey？
Um, I'm actually waiting for someone...
We have a more detailed survey just over that way...
No, really, I'm meeting someone here...
Sorry, we're on our way somewhere. Excuse us. Come on, let's go!
...Thanks, you saved me. It's hard to turn them down when they're so polite.
Geez, you're way too nice. ...Though that's part of your charm, too.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Shall we go？
Yeah. Huh？ Isn't that... Mr. Oyama, the guidance counselor, over there？
Sorry, looks like it was someone else. You didn't have to freak out so much.
I thought my heart was gonna stop...
Geez, it's not like we're doing anything bad, right？
Right at the same time, huh？ And here I wanted to get here first and wait for you.
I'm just glad I wasn't late.
Fufu... Is that interesting new look in style these days？
Quick answer, very good. Alright, you're forgiven.
No, I'm sorry too... Wait, huh？
What do you know, we were both late. Fufu, that's funny.
Neither of us had to wait, so all's well that ends well, I guess？
Sorry I'm late! Wait, what's wrong？
Wait, are you crying？ Um, I'm really sorry for being late!
Oh, stop it. I just got something in my eye. Freaking out like that... You're so cute.
Divine punishment for being late, maybe？
Sorry, I kept you waiting, didn't I？
Geez, look at that face. I was gonna lecture you, but I just can't...
(Crap! I have to hurry... Even if I do, I'm still late, though.)
I was just about to ring the doorbell, and then...
Nope, not all right at all.
Hehe. As punishment, you'd better show me a really good time today.
(Whoa, is it that late already?! Crap, this is bad!)
I came to see the face of the terrible boyfriend who kept his girlfriend waiting.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! I'm sorry! I'll be ready in a second.
Oh, all right. Hate the sin, not the boyfriend. Right？
It's our date, and it's cloudy... Kind of a bummer.
Sorry, did I keep you waiting？ I ran out of time doing my UV protection.
No, not at all, but... UV protection？ It's cloudy though？
Sunny or cloudy, the amount of UV rays is the same, you know.
Ah, sorry. I just got a little startled.
Sorry to keep you waiting. The rain's really picking up.
What？ It's hard to hear you over the rain.
You didn't have to get that close!
Yeah, thanks. Your clothes... got wet, though.
I'm fine, really. Just a bit. It'll dry in no time.
It's snowing out, so it really is chilly...
Yeah, I'm team cat, curling up in a kotatsu. How about you？ Team dog？
●？ ● would rather... be in the kotatsu with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez, smooth talker. ...Still, full marks for that answer.
Sorry to keep you waiting... Why's your mouth open？
It's snowing, so I thought I'd try catching some on my tongue.
Haha, you're scolding me like a little baby.
Because you're acting like a kid! Snow only looks clean on the outside. You'll get a stomachache!
(She sounds like she's speaking from experience. Don't tell me...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, sorry to keep you waiting... The wind is crazy, are you okay？
That surprised me. ...Were you hoping for something just now？
Too bad for you. My wind protection is flawless.
(Oh well. Not like I want other guys looking anyway.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
The wind blew my handkerchief right away...
Hah, hah... Here, I found it.
Sorry, you worked up a sweat. Here, use the handk—wait, it just got dirty, didn't it.
Don't worry about it. The breeze feels nice today anyway.
Hmm... Can't even tell me what you think right away？
I'm not so sure about it
Never mind, then. Sorry for putting you on the spot.
Thanks for this. I put it on right away.
Do you remember this？ It's one of my favorites now.
I thought I'd change up my look a bit. What do... you think？
Geez, you're exaggerating. Still... it makes me happy.
I see, thank you. I'm really glad.
Not interested at all, huh. Too bad.
What's wrong？ You went completely quiet...
What is it, did something happen？
Why not try a new hairstyle？
How about a different hair color？
How about changing your hair length？
Yeah. If that's what you say, maybe I'll change it.
I actually really like my hair right now, though... Let me think about it.
If there's something on your mind, don't hold back, okay？
What's the matter？ Just say what's on your mind, okay？
I just changed it, though... Don't tell me you didn't notice？
If it's hard to say, you don't have to force yourself, okay？
Hey, don't you think my hair's grown？ I'm torn on whether to cut it, what do you think？
I'd rather you not cut it
I think you should cut it
Really？ Well, if you say so, maybe I'll keep growing it out.
Yeah, got it. I had a feeling you'd say that.
What's wrong？ Not interested in me？
I changed my hair, what do you think？ Take a good look, okay？
Did you notice I dyed my hair？ Come on, tell me what you think.
That color doesn't really suit you.
I went a little bold with it. What do you think？
It's kind of a fail, isn't it...
Whew, good. I was a little worried.
I see... Bummer. Thanks for being honest with me, though.
...Don't look so troubled. Sorry about that.
Hey, let's get some lunch. I'm already starving.
It's this late already？ What should we do for dinner？
Come to think of it, aren't you hungry？
Yeah, I was thinking there too.
Yeah, good idea. Just something light.
Oh, look. The sky's brightening up.
Huh, it got cloudy. Hope it doesn't rain.
Ah... snow. No wonder it felt so cold. Feels like a nice little treat.
Huh, looks like it started raining.
You're right. Oh well... Should we go somewhere else？
If that's where you want... Sure, okay.
Could it be？ Hehe, you don't have to say it.
Nooo way... Just kidding, I won't say that.
Hmm. Is that so？ No way, not right now〜
Too bad, not right now. Some other time, okay？
Yeah. But look, people are watching... okay？
Ah, you don't mean... Nope, not happening. People are watching.
Look... people are watching. Be a good boy and wait, okay？
Sorry. I'm just not in the mood...
Right now？ I'm not really in the mood, I think.
Do you really have to？ Still, no. Next time, okay？
Sorry, but we'll get wet in the rain...
Hey, we'll get wet in the rain. You'll have to wait.
Geez, cut it out. You'll stick out of the umbrella.
Sorry... no... Some other time, okay？
Hmm... I'm not really in the mood, you know？ Sorry.
Hmm... I'd like you to think about how I feel a little, you know？
Yeah, sure... It's a little embarrassing, though.
Sure, but make sure I look pretty！ Got it？
If you don't make me look cute... you know what happens, right？
Sorry... Does it have to be right now？
Nope. I'd rather wait for next time.
It doesn't have to be right now, does it？ Please？
I'm a little hungry... Wanna grab something to eat？
Let's go get some lunch. I'm starving.
Is it that time already？ Wanna go eat something？
I'm with you. Honestly, I was getting hungry too.
Um... I think I'm okay for now.
We're already here. Time flies when I'm with you.
Yeah, it really went by in a flash.
Look, we're here. That was faster than I thought.
Oh, you have an umbrella... Guess we can't share one.
Why'd you have to go and bring an umbrella...？
Wait, was that a bad move？
Aww, and here I was hoping I could share mine with you.
Hey, you'll get soaked. Come on, get under.
Forgot your umbrella？ Well then... come on, let's share.
Aren't you lucky you have such a sweet older girlfriend？ Come on, let's share.
Forgetting an umbrella isn't so bad after all.
● has an umbrella, so let's share.
Sorry about that. Though... maybe forgetting it was a good thing. Hehe.
I've got an umbrella. Come share with me.
Aw, aren't you thoughtful. Thank you.
Can't believe ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ forgot an umbrella. Here, get in closer.
Don't mind if I do, then. Maybe slipping up once in a while isn't so bad.
We don't have an umbrella. Let's run!
Sorry, I forgot mine! Let's hurry.
Hey, can I... get a little closer to you？
Hey... you know what to do at times like this, right？
Hey, maybe I'll get even closer... Would you like that？
I'll snuggle up extra close to you... Hehe▼
It's so warm... I really like this.
Hm？ Is this... where we're having our date today？
Huh？ ...Sorry, looks like I went the wrong way.
Hmm, want to hang out here instead, since we're already here？
(If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s fine with it, I guess that works...)
Wait... Hey, are you sure this is the right way？
Huh？ ...Ah, I took a wrong turn.
Going back now would waste time, so let's just stay here.
(If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s fine with it, I guess that works...)
There's so much here. Care to show me your favorites？
Hey, which one do you think looks fun？
There are so many. Which one do you want？
That was so much fun! Wanna play a little more？
Hmm, that's pretty fun. Wanna keep playing a bit longer？
Oh, that looks fun. I'd love to try it.
You're really good at this. But... it's about time, don't you think？
I think that's enough for now, don't you think？
Hey, if you'd like... wanna eat lunch？ I made us some.
Hehe. I actually brought lunch today, you know.
Today, it's a homemade lunch by yours truly▼
In that case, wanna come over to ●'s place？
Not really feeling that spot... Let's head home today, okay？
Yeah... bummer, but let's do that.
Your place？ Hmm... yeah, I'd like that.
Hey, isn't that couple over there from Dixie's？
You're right. Those two were dating...？
Come to think of it, the manager said more people at work started dating after us.
That's the power of ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for you.
You mean both of us, right？ We have to be a model couple, you know？
That sounds way too wholesome. Kinda boring, honestly.
Hey now! Being an unwholesome couple is strictly forbidden!
You've got something in your hair. Hold on, let me...
Huh？ I'm sorry! I pulled a hair out with it. Did that hurt？
Thanks. Oh, I haven't seen this kind before.
I found a new one! Look, isn't the mascot character so cute？
(Kinda looks like a raccoon... Is that really cute？)
Lately, dieting has been all the rage in my class...
Do you think I should go on a diet too？
You don't need to at all. I like you just the way you are.
I knew you'd say that! I'm totally telling everyone what you just said.
That kinda sounds like you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
The other day, a foreigner asked me for directions.
Were you able to tell them？
Yeah, though neither Japanese nor English worked. Looking them in the eye while talking somehow got it across!
I want to rent a DVD later. Can you remind me？
Yep. I saw it a long time ago, but every now and then I get this huge urge to rewatch it.
You like it that much？ I'd love to watch it with you.
Ah, you just looked away! Where were your eyes wandering, hmm？
You can't fool me. If you get caught staring at another girl again... I'll get mad, okay？
Hey, I came up with a great way to study the other day.
Ooh, what is it？ Tell me!
Well, it's not pushing too hard all at once. If you spike it up too fast, keeping it up is tough, right？
Ah, I get it, but that feels a little passive, doesn't it？
You think？ An expert said the golden rule of dieting is taking it slow and steady.
What's wrong, did you bump yourself？
Yeah... Well, I don't really know. I just noticed a bruise popped up... Did I bump it somewhere？
I'm getting hungry... Wanna grab some dinner？
I actually made us lunch today. I hope you like it.
It's still early, wanna hang out a bit longer？
We've still got time, right？ I'd love to hang out some more. What do you think？
Do you have time？ I want to stay with you a bit longer.
Yeah. I want to spend more time with you too.
Sure. A little longer should be fine.
Really？ Where should we go, then？
I'd love to, but I've got something after this... Sorry, okay？
I want to stay with you too, but... I'm out of time. Sorry, okay？
No good, huh... Let's do it next time, then.
...Sorry, I think I should just head home today.
Today's a bit... Ah, and it's getting late anyway, you know？
I got a little tired... Um, can I lean on your shoulder？
Hey, how about an offer from me？ Can I borrow your shoulder？
Maybe I'll spoil myself a bit... and lean on you？
You're so warm... Yeah, this feels nice.
Hey... You can lean on me too, you know？
Isn't this what you wanted？ Hehe▼
We're there already？ I feel like staying on forever.
We're almost there. A little disappointed, maybe？
Phew... I guess I got a little tired.
Hey, we're almost there, you know？
Mmh... Ah. I fell asleep before I even realized... Sorry.
Aren't you tired？ You can lean on my shoulder if you'd like.
Oh, look at you being so smooth. ...Well, don't mind if I do？
Mm... It's really calming, isn't it？
...I guess that's pretty manly of you, maybe？
Hearing you say that makes me really happy.
Hehe▼ Your face is all red.
Wanna come to ●'s place？ I thought it'd be nice if we stayed together longer.
Yeah, let's. I want to be together, too...
I'm sorry... I think I'll pass for today.
Could I maybe come over to your place？
Really？ Wow, now I'm getting kind of nervous.
Haha. Let's head over right away, then.
Ah... it was sudden, huh. Yeah... next time is totally fine.
I brought a present today. Hope you like it.
What is it？ Honestly... you can be so clingy.
We're all done for today. See you next time, okay？
You know... I really don't want to leave you.
(Man... and the mood was so good, too.)
Anegasaki-san. If your family's growing, I have a bigger room open, you know？
Oh stop, you're getting way ahead of yourself! Nothing like that's happening yet.
Hey, if you have time, why not stop by my place？
If you'd like, why don't you come on inside？
Really？ Wait just a sec, okay？ I'll go check my room first.
Haha, you don't need to worry about that.
Thanks for today. I had so much fun. See you later!
Um... We had fun today, right？ Well then, see you.
Um... I'm sorry. It feels like I held you back... Well then, bye.
Hey... You're not mad about our fight the other day, are you？
I'm not mad. I'm totally over it.
You're so sweet... Then let's get back to normal from today, okay？
Hey. We're all good now, right？
I've already forgiven you. Will you forgive me, too？
I was really happy we could make up today.
● too. I'm definitely done with fighting.
Let's get even closer from now on, okay？
